subject: VapiCon - Coffee?
text:
Hi [NAME]

I saw you focus on conversational speech models so I expect you might be at
VapiCon next week. I wanted to reach out for a coffee and learn how you're
thinking about data quality.

I've been working on projects with Udio, Kyutai and Speechmatics in similar
spaces to you. That seems to be a common challenge for Voice AI teams which
in turn affects the word error rate and output naturalism.

We've been approaching this from a tooling angle - e.g. unifying
pre-labelling, manual adjustment and QA in one place for transcription,
diarization and emotion/ sentiment recognition.

Would love to hear how you're approaching this. My team will be at VapiCon
all day on 2nd Oct - if you're open to a quick chat?

subject: Congrats on the IPO!
text:
Hi [NAME],

Just saw the great news about Kodiak's IPO! Hope you're celebrating for
this huge day!

I saw you're recently hiring for an AI engineer for flywheel automation &
thought automating annotations is something we can collaborate on.

Our customer Woven by Toyota leverage us to curate, annotate & evaluate
petabytes of self-driving training data - which I imagine is at comparable
scale to Kodiak. - keen to get your thoughts on how we've approached that
project.

Let me know if you have 30 mins in the coming week? Until then hope you're
celebrating in style!

subject: Coffee at VapiCon?
text:
Hi [NAME],

Congrats on Chatterbox Multilingual's recent launch! Given your focus on
TTS/ASR I thought you might be at VapiCon next week - would love to grab a
coffee if you're heading there.

For context - I'm working on data ops projects with Speechmatics, Kyutai
and Udio in audio AI space, helping them build more accurate multilingual
datasets with the objective of reducing word error rate and increasing
naturalism of model outputs.

We focus on unifying auto-annotation and manual adjustment/ human QA in one
platform, so annotators can focus on assessing labelling accuracy for
transcription, diarization and non-speech contexts.

Would you be open to a chat? We'll be at VapiCon all day on 2nd Oct.

subject: ITC Vegas catch up with Ravin
text:
Hi [NAME],

Congrats on being selected to speak at ITC Vegas!

I'll be following but wanted to reach out since we already work with some
of your peers (Intenseye, UVeye, Tractable) on their annotation workflows
for car damage detection + assessment.

We've seen CV teams in auto insurance cut model iteration time by
automating edge-case QA and streamlining review workflow (something I
imagine is also top of mind for Ravin).

Curious if you'd be open to a virtual coffee before the event to compare
notes. Happy to work around your schedule.

subject: training data pipeline @ [COMPANY]
text:
Hi [NAME],

Congrats on your recent partnership with Skydio! Thought I'd reach out
since Skydio is also a customer.

We've been working with them and other inspection companies like Zeitview,
Buzz, Tractable on similar computer vision models for diverse environments.
Their CV teams turn to us because they often face challenges as they scale
with managing massive volumes of video, images and 3D training data.

Quick context on Encord: we're a data development platform for advanced CV
and multimodal AI. We bring data curation, annotation, workflow management
& model evaluation into one place, so teams can focus more on building
better models.

Keen to hear if these challenges resonate and how you're thinking about
your training data as you scale. I'm flexible Tuesdays to Thursdays if you
are open to chat.

subject: training data pipeline @ imubit
text:
Hi [NAME],

I read about [COMPANY]'s partnership with Preem to lower emissions, great work
for driving sustainability in industrial AI (and making the earth greener!)
Thought I'd reach out as we work with companies like Zeitview, Buzz
solutions and Baker Hughes on similar CV projects to detect defects / leaks
at oil rigs and other power plants.

We've been helping their teams scale annotation for high-volume, complex
datasets so they can accelerate model development, improve predictive
accuracy, and deploy AI faster. Curious to learn if CV inspection is on
[COMPANY]'s roadmap as well.

Quick context on Encord: we're a data development platform for advanced CV
and multimodal AI (image, video, 3D, sensor etc). We bring data curation,
annotation, workflow mgmt & model evaluation into one platform, so teams
can focus more on building better AI models.

Do you have time over the next week or two to learn more? Let me know what
works for you, and I'll send a calendar invite along accordingly.

subject: Boston Dinner - Encord
text:
[NAME] - thought of you as we'll be hosting a dinner in Boston on 15th Oct.
Would love to have you join and hear what you're up to since the Las Vegas
launch!

It will be a small gathering for 15 Physical AI leaders, starting from

etc.

Would love for you to join - can you make it?
